  "items": [

      "category": "domain_extent",

      "description": "Sec. 4.1 specifies Lx:Ly = 6:1 but gives no absolute dimensions or coordinate normalization. Its relationship to the numerical filter radius is therefore unresolved.",

        "Full beam: Lx = 6, Ly = 1 model length units.",
        "Full beam: Lx = 180, Ly = 30 model length units."

      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The 2-D formulation and Sec. 4.1.1 do not specify the constant thickness used to form element stiffnesses and volumes.",
      "readings": [
        "Constant thickness t = 1 model length unit.",
        "Constant thickness t = 0.1 model length unit."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "element counts on the optimized right half",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 gives 180 by 30 elements before saying that the right symmetric half is optimized. Appendix B explicitly uses 90 by 30 elements on the symmetric half and repeats the single-material CASE III objective and non-discreteness values.",
      "readings": [
        "180 by 30 describes the full beam; optimize a 90 by 30 right half.",
        "180 by 30 describes the optimized right half; its mirrored full mesh is 360 by 30."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "nodal spacing within the structured mesh",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 4 and 4.1.1 specify bilinear quadrilaterals and element counts, but do not explicitly specify uniform spacing or nodal coordinates.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform Cartesian spacing in both directions.",
        "A graded structured grid, for example x_i = (Lx/2)i/Nx and y_j = Ly(j/Ny)^2 on the right half."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "physical bearing locations",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 calls the beam simply supported and refers to Fig. 2a, but the prose does not give bearing coordinates.",
      "readings": [
        "Bearings at the two bottom corners: (0,0) and (Lx,0).",
        "Bearings at the midpoints of the vertical end edges: (0,Ly/2) and (Lx,Ly/2).",
        "Bearings on the bottom edge, one element column inward from each end."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "spatial extent of each bearing constraint",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The Fig. 2a reference and later mentions of support portions do not specify whether displacement constraints act at individual nodes or over finite bearing regions.",
      "readings": [
        "One supported node per bearing.",
        "Vertical displacement constrained at two adjacent boundary nodes per bearing.",
        "Vertical displacement constrained over a boundary bearing segment of length Ly/10."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_type",
      "entity": "pin and roller assignment on the full beam",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The prose identifies a simply supported MBB problem and later mentions hinge and roller supports, but does not assign them to sides or explicitly enumerate their displacement constraints.",
      "readings": [
        "Left bearing: ux = uy = 0; right bearing: uy = 0 with ux free.",
        "Left bearing: uy = 0 with ux free; right bearing: ux = uy = 0."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "point force used in the symmetry-reduced model",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 specifies a force of 10^-3 at the full beam's upper midpoint; Sec. 4.1.1 optimizes the right half without stating whether that force is halved on the symmetry boundary.",
      "readings": [
        "Apply 5 × 10^-4 downward to the half model, representing a full-beam force of 10^-3.",
        "Apply 10^-3 downward to the half model, representing a full-beam force of 2 × 10^-3."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "MBB design mask near the load and supports",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 reports material occupying load and support regions, but supplies no passive-element mask or explicit statement that every element is designable.",
      "readings": [
        "All elements are designable; no passive solid or void regions.",
        "Elements immediately adjacent to the load and physical bearings are fixed solid.",
        "Two-by-two element pads adjoining the load and physical bearings are fixed solid."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 supplies normalized Young's modulus, but no Poisson's ratio is specified for the 2-D elastic element formulation.",
      "readings": [
        "Common Poisson's ratio nu = 0.25.",
        "Common Poisson's ratio nu = 0.30.",
        "Common Poisson's ratio nu = 1/3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "2-D constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The paper specifies a 2-D elastic problem with bilinear quadrilateral elements, but does not choose plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress.",
        "Plane strain."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "ersatz void stiffness Emin",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 and Eq. 33 describe Emin only as a very small stiffness used to avoid singularity; no numerical value is supplied.",
      "readings": [
        "Emin/Esolid = 10^-9.",
        "Emin/Esolid = 10^-6.",
        "Emin/Esolid = 10^-3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "units of the density-filter radius in CASE II and CASE III",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 gives rmin = 3.6, while Eqs. 27–28 use center-to-center distances. No length unit or nondimensionalization is stated.",
      "readings": [
        "Radius equals 3.6 element heights: rmin = 0.12 Ly.",
        "Radius equals 3.6 element widths; for a 180-by-30 right-half mesh this is rmin = 0.06 Ly.",
        "Radius equals 3.6 coordinate length units, including when Ly is normalized to 1."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "density filtering across the vertical symmetry cut",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Eq. 27 specifies normalized neighboring-element weights, but Sec. 4.1.1 does not say whether the filter is assembled on the retained half or on the mirrored full domain.",
      "readings": [
        "Filter only existing half-domain elements and renormalize the truncated neighborhood at the symmetry cut.",
        "Include reflected neighbors across the cut, equivalently filtering the mirrored full field before retaining the right half."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "initial single-material design field",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 gives no initial natural coordinate or density field. The initial-guess studies elsewhere concern different examples or material counts.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform unfiltered, unprojected solid density of 0.30.",
        "Uniform unfiltered, unprojected solid density of 0.50, corresponding to natural coordinate zero.",
        "An alternating initial solid-density field of 0.29 and 0.31."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "MMA update and subproblem parameters",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 names MMA but does not specify move limits, asymptote initialization and update factors, auxiliary penalty parameters, or subproblem tolerances.",
      "readings": [
        "Initial asymptote distance 0.5 times the variable-bound span; expansion/contraction factors 1.2/0.7; maximum raw-coordinate step 0.2; auxiliary penalties c = 1000, d = 0; subproblem KKT tolerance 10^-7.",
        "Initial asymptote distance 0.25 times the variable-bound span; expansion/contraction factors 1.1/0.5; maximum raw-coordinate step 0.1; auxiliary penalties c = 100, d = 0; subproblem KKT tolerance 10^-5."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "MMA history at projection-continuation changes in CASE III",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 specifies projection-parameter doubling, but does not state whether MMA asymptotes and iteration history are retained or restarted when the parameter changes.",
      "readings": [
        "Retain MMA asymptotes and previous-iterate history through every projection update.",
        "Restart MMA asymptotes and history at each projection update while retaining the current design."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "outer optimization stopping criterion",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 specifies a maximum of 400 MMA iterations, but gives no early-stopping criterion or confirmation that every Table 2 run executes exactly 400 updates.",
      "readings": [
        "Execute exactly 400 MMA updates.",
        "Stop when the maximum raw-coordinate change is below 10^-3, subject to the 400-iteration cap and completion of projection continuation where applicable.",
        "Stop when relative objective change remains below 10^-4 for ten iterations, subject to the 400-iteration cap."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "bilinear quadrilateral stiffness integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 specifies bilinear quadrilateral elements, but does not specify integration or stabilization. This is particularly relevant to the unfiltered checkerboard assessment in CASE I.",
      "readings": [
        "Full two-by-two Gaussian integration.",
        "One-point reduced integration with hourglass stabilization."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "linear equilibrium solution method and accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. 34 specifies KU = F, but no linear-solver method or numerical convergence tolerance is reported.",
      "readings": [
        "Sparse direct factorization.",
        "Preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 10^-8.",
        "Preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 10^-4."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
